blocks.text: Thank you for turning the quarterly figures around so quickly; that was the piece we were waiting on, and it lets the rest fall into place. Melissa Zimmerman is finalizing the fact sheet against the numbers you sent, and it should be settled in the next day or two.

Kimberly Le has a first draft of the talking points ready, built on that same set of numbers so the fact sheet and the messaging stay consistent. She has also flagged a couple of angles in the current coverage that we would do well to get ahead of, and I would rather walk you through those on a call than write them all out here.

I think a short call early next week is the right next step for the {{fact:f:E-2022-001.client}} program. Send me two or three windows that work for you, Sandra Mcdaniel, and I will confirm one and bring Kimberly Le and Melissa Zimmerman in, so you hear the detail straight from them.
